messages:
rachel (producer): Uploaded NimbusFlow case interview + transcript: https://files.redwood/nimbusflow-cutA.mp4. Need quick legal on hero line, product to confirm tech callouts, and routing for leads. Proposed embargo 2025-08-14 08:00 PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Nice. Can we keep hero to one short sentence? Also planning blog + 45s social clip.

rachel (producer): Hero candidate: "NimbusFlow reduced inference spend 3.2x with Redwood Dedicated and saw steadier P95 latency."

ben (legal): Flag: change exact multiplier to approximate (~3x) unless finance signs off. Replace "reduced" with "helped reduce" if we don't own the metric lineage. Also we need the benchmark appendix and signed release for any raw charts.

oliver (solutions): Product note: P95 delta is from our A/B run vs prior infra. I'll attach a short tech note explaining the config used so marketing copy is accurate.

marta (prod-marketing): Revised short hero for landing: "Redwood helped NimbusFlow reduce inference spend ~3x while stabilizing tail latency." Ok to use that?

ben (legal): That phrasing is fine conditional on appendix attached. I'll sign off once I get transcript + appendix in the approval email.

sam (sales-ops): Lead routing: route form leads to SDR-Nimbus queue and add tag source=case-nimbusflow. Webhook sample:```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead-route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-nimbusflow","queue":"SDR-Nimbus"}'``` I'll add campaign=nimbusflow-q3-2025.

kate (growth): Suggest a follow-up webinar: "NimbusFlow migration playbook" two weeks after embargo — 2025-08-28 11:00 PT. Short Q&A drive. Will A/B test hero vs CTA to webinar.

marta (prod-marketing): Speakers: NimbusFlow infra lead + Redwood soleng. Rachel please draft 1-pager and a 3-point demo checklist for CS.

rachel (producer): On it. Uploading one-pager and redacted perf CSV to Drive now.

publish-bot: upload complete: nimbusflow-cutA.mp4 (88MB)

sam (sales-ops): I'll schedule a smoke test on 2025-08-12 09:00 PT to post a sample lead and confirm routing to #sdr-nimbus.

ben (legal): Sent preliminary approval email pending appendix attachment. Once appendix is attached here, I'll send final approval.

marta (prod-marketing): Timeline recap: legal & appendix by 2025-08-10, final edit by 2025-08-11, landing & routing ready 2025-08-12, embargo 2025-08-14 08:00 PT, webinar 2025-08-28 11:00 PT. Keep embargo internal.

oliver (solutions): Uploaded tech note to thread. //config: batch_size=64, kv_cache on, quantize=8bit.

kate (growth): I'll scaffold landing + UTMs and drop hero mock in #design-requests.

rachel (producer): Closing - assets uploaded, legal looped, product provided tech note. Will post final edit when ready.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks team. End of thread.
